name: The Venture Co.
summary: In Mulgore's eastern hills, goblins dig despite the tauren's refusal. The Venture Co. brings them in force to quarry the Earth Mother's soil, and Morin Cloudstalker calls for a lethal answer.

sections.title: Industrial Intrusion
sections.body: The tauren honor Mulgore as part of the Earth Mother. They value its open plains and the balance of its wildlife. When the Venture Company asks to blast and excavate the hills for ore, the tribes refuse. The company ignores them and brings machinery, laborers, and overseers into the eastern ridges to mine without permission.

sections.title: An Unmistakable Message
sections.body: Morin Cloudstalker and the other tauren scouts see no use in further appeals once the mining begins. Documents from a ravaged Venture Co. caravan confirm the operation. Morin sends you against the overseers who crack the whips and the laborers who drive the drills. He means for the company to pay dearly for trespassing.

faq.q: Why is the Venture Company in Mulgore?
faq.answer: The Venture Company digs in Mulgore's eastern hills for ore and other resources. The tauren refused its request for mining rights, but the company set up operations anyway.

faq.q: Who gave the order to attack the miners?
faq.answer: Morin Cloudstalker gives the order. Keeping watch near Bloodhoof Village, he sees the company's refusal to accept the tauren's decision as a violation that calls for force.

faq.q: Where is the Venture Company mine located?
faq.answer: The main Venture Company Mine lies in the foothills east of the Ravaged Caravan and Bloodhoof Village. Company personnel also gather at a smaller outpost in the bluffs northeast of Thunder Bluff's northern elevators.

faq.q: Did the tauren ever try to negotiate with the goblins?
faq.answer: Yes. The Venture Company asked the tauren for mining rights in Mulgore, and the tribal leaders refused permission to strip-mine their ancestral lands. The goblins dug without permission anyway.

faq.q: Are these goblins part of the Steamwheedle Cartel?
faq.answer: No. The Venture Company is an independent, predatory industrial cartel, separate from neutral trading groups such as the Steamwheedle Cartel. It has hostile relations with local people wherever it exploits resources.

faq.q: How does this connect to the ravaged caravans?
faq.answer: The ravaged caravan was a Venture Company convoy the tauren destroyed. Crates and documents from its mining division revealed the company's operation in Mulgore, prompting the strike on its mine.

angles.text: For the tauren, the Earth Mother is sacred. The Venture Company's mining desecrates their ancestral home, and they mean to drive the goblins out by force.
As a member of the Horde, you help defend Mulgore from commercial exploitation and protect Cairne Bloodhoof's people as they secure their new homeland.
The Venture Company mines by brute force, cutting corners and destabilizing the land without regard for its natural balance or safe mining practice.
